headline: Executive order directs the Department of Energy to change how it tests new nuclear reactor designs.
what_it_does: This order, signed May 23, 2025, tells the Department of Energy to reform its process for testing nuclear reactors. No summary was provided, so the specific changes, deadlines, and requirements are not described here. Based on the title, it likely deals with how reactor designs are tested at Energy Department sites.

who_it_affects.group: Companies developing new nuclear reactor designs
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how their reactors can be tested through the Department of Energy.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Energy and its national laboratories
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to change their reactor testing programs and procedures.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 23, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
